items.source: RestTemplate and RestClient share the same infrastructure (i.e. request factories, request interceptors and initializers, message converters, etc.), so any improvements made therein are shared as well. However, RestClient is the focus for new higher-level features.
items.translation: RestTemplate 和 RestClient 共享相同的基础设施（即请求工厂、请求拦截器和初始化器，消息转换器等），因此在此处进行的任何改进也会共享。然而，RestClient 是新高级功能的重点。

items.source: NOTE: As of 6.1, RestClient offers a more modern API for synchronous HTTP access. For asynchronous and streaming scenarios, consider the reactive WebClient.
items.translation: 注意： 自 6.1 版本起，RestClient 提供了用于同步 HTTP 访问的更现代 API。对于异步和流式处理场景，请考虑使用响应式的WebClient。

items.source: RestTemplate is typically used as a shared component. However, its configuration does not support concurrent modification, and as such its configuration is typically prepared on startup. If necessary, you can create multiple, differently configured RestTemplate instances on startup. Such instances may use the same underlying ClientHttpRequestFactory if they need to share HTTP client resources.
items.translation: RestTemplate 通常用作共享组件。然而，其配置不支持并发修改，因此通常在启动时准备其配置。如有必要，您可以在启动时创建多个具有不同配置的 RestTemplate 实例。如果它们需要共享 HTTP 客户端资源，这些实例可以使用相同的底层 ClientHttpRequestFactory。

items.source:
Execute the request specified in the given RequestEntity and return the response as ResponseEntity. The given ParameterizedTypeReference is used to pass generic type information: 
MyRequest body = ...
RequestEntity request = RequestEntity
    .post(URI.create("https://example.com/foo"))
    .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    .body(body);
ParameterizedTypeReference<List<MyResponse>> myBean =
    new ParameterizedTypeReference<List<MyResponse>>() {};
ResponseEntity<List<MyResponse>> response = template.exchange(request, myBean);

Execute the request specified in the given RequestEntity and return the response as ResponseEntity. Typically used in combination with the static builder methods on RequestEntity, for instance: 
MyRequest body = ...
RequestEntity request = RequestEntity
    .post(URI.create("https://example.com/foo"))
    .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    .body(body);
ResponseEntity<MyResponse> response = template.exchange(request, MyResponse.class);
